python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, re
from datetime import date, timedelta
from collections import defaultdict

ref = date(2025,8,12)
ranges = {
 'today': (ref, ref),
 'last_7_days': (ref - timedelta(days=6), ref),
 'last_30_days': (ref - timedelta(days=29), ref),
 'month_to_date': (date(2025,8,1), ref),
 'total': None,
}
sev_re = re.compile(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO)\]')
counts = {p: defaultdict(int) for p in ranges}
for fn in os.listdir('/app/logs'):
    m = re.match(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_.*\.log$', fn)
    if not m: continue
    d = date.fromisoformat(m.group(1))
    file_counts = defaultdict(int)
    with open(os.path.join('/app/logs',fn)) as f:
        for line in f:
            sm = sev_re.search(line)
            if sm: file_counts[sm.group(1)] += 1
    for p, rng in ranges.items():
        if rng is None or rng[0] <= d <= rng[1]:
            for s in ('ERROR','WARNING','INFO'):
                counts[p][s] += file_counts[s]
with open('/app/summary.csv','w') as out:
    out.write('period,severity,count\n')
    for p in ('today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date','total'):
        for s in ('ERROR','WARNING','INFO'):
            out.write(f'{p},{s},{counts[p][s]}\n')
print(open('/app/summary.csv').read())
EOF
